products.title: Coffee Table - Calix - Rectangular - By Baxter
products.description_html:
The Calix collection of wooden coffee tables and consoles by Baxter captures a refined elegance, drawing inspiration from the pure elegance of nature with its sculptural, rounded lines. Each element conveys a conversation between tradition and innovation. The sturdy frame, made from solid lime wood, takes centre stage with its polished black shellac finish, which beautifully highlights the wood's natural grain. The matt scratched shelf introduces a tactile and visual contrast, adding depth and character. The sinuous and organic forms of Calix recall the timeless elegance of ethnic and ritual art transformed into a functional work. Available in different sizes, the coffee table and console lend themselves to multiple furnishing interpretations, embracing a cultured and sophisticated taste.

DIMENSIONS :

W. 184 cm | D. 84 cm | H. 24 cm

products.title: Coffee Table - Allure - By Baxter
products.description_html:
The Allure metal coffee table enhances living rooms with an interpretation of the circle in three different scales, balancing these with a single rectangle concept. A contemporary, unexpected interpretation of more conventional living room furniture geometries that invites us to play with the senses. Beneath the antiqued metal surface with shiny and matt hues, in the pleats of the base, a glimpse of functional and stable Doric columns which, up close, recall the conceptual architecture of 20th century northern Europe. 

DIMENSIONS :

W. 180 cm | D. 77 cm | H. 25 cm

Available in alpacca brass and copper.

products.title: Coffee Table - Aegates - 6 - By Baxter
products.description_html:
Each coffee table in the Aegates collection is an unusual, ironic island, a combination of joints and gaps with an organic shape that seems smoothed by the flow of water and time. The single coffee table can be arranged in pairs – for a versatile double tabletop – or in multiple tabletop compositions, reminiscent of the archipelago of islands from which the name is derived and to best meet the changing demands of life and space. The functionality of the tabletop (in different heights and sizes) is combined with the originality of the nature-inspired design and the variety of available finishes. From poplar briar, which forms the larger pieces, to the glossy, vibrant colours of the lacquered variants, available for small and large tables.

DIMENSIONS: 
W. 86 cm | D. 117 cm | H. 28 cm 

Available in 100 gloss lacquered MDF or in solid natural poplar briar.

A sculptural piece with thin sheet metal that reflects light like a mirror, creating functional surfaces for a coffee table or bedside table in every curve.

products.title: Coffee Table - Teso - By Foster + Partners
products.description_html:
Teso, design Foster+Partners, is a sculptural objet highly unusually shaped. The table’s base is formed by a robotic arm, which is used to press and twist a perforated disc of steel into a tough, tapered cylinder.
Functionality is guaranteed by extra light (ø 118) transparent glass tops that reveal the complexity of the structural forms from whichever angle you observe them.

Dimensions
ø 118 x H31 cm

products.title: Coffee Table - LessLess - By Jean Nouvel
products.description_html:
An aluminum table the strength of which lies in a play on corners and folds.
The external outline of the horizontal table top is very thin and stiffness and is obtained by bending the aluminium sheet along inclined planes. designed originally for the Fondation Cartier in Paris, lessless is a complete range of tables, high and low, rectangular and square. Available in several colors.

products.title: Coffee Table - Hubert - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Set of small tables specifically designed by Vincent Van Duysen to go with the Gregor sofa. They echo the rounded angles of the sofa to create a harmonious whole.

Square or rectangular, these are occasional tables each with two wooden horizontal tops, supported by curved hide leather-covered vertical elements, which form a partially closed compartment between the top and the shelf below, designed to hold various handy objects for those sitting on the sofa

products.title: Coffee Table - Panna Cotta - By Ron Gilad
products.description_html:
Panna Cotta low table oval or round. At once delicate and heavy, the paradox lies in the use of materials such as marble and iron to achieve a fragile stability.
A small table, it has a slight wave on top reminiscent of the typical Italian soft dessert, from which it takes its name.

products.title: Coffee Table - D.555.1 - By Gio Ponti
products.description_html:
From Gio Ponti’s house, located in via Dezza in Milan, the small table D.555.1, designed in 1954-1955, is produced by Molteni&C based on the original drawings from the ponti archives.
It completes the Gio Ponti Collection which was a furnishing range designed by the architect between 1935 and 1950s. Metal hand painted structure and glass top.

Dimensions
⌀80 x H37 cm

products.title: Coffee Table - D.552.2 - By Gio Ponti
products.description_html:
Architecture, a pan virtuosity, acrobatic proportions and an intersection of joints. An infinite table which is a geometric dialogue between the glass and rosewood – lightness and abstraction distilled.
D.552.2 small table, in wood with a glass top, designed for the American company The D.552.2 small table, made of solid rosewood with satinized bronze legs and an ultra light transparent triangular top, belongs to this collection destined for the American market. The revision of the D.552.2 table curated by Molteni&C is part of the Gio Ponti Collection.

products.title: Coffee Table - Cleo - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Cleo is a small domestic sculpture that derives from the professional experience of architect and creative director Vincent Van Duysen.

With its geometric shape reminiscent of an oval, this small table set is a natural complement to the Cleo seating modular system designed by Vincent van Duysen.

The top is thicker in the middle in order to accommodate the solid Eucalyptus, Black Oak and Sunrise Oak supporting legs, curved according to the profile of the top. The profile of the top becomes slims down towards the free sides, tapering almost to the width of a blade. Available in two heights and two different dimensions.

products.title: Coffee Table - Fonte - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Refined craftsmanship meets innovation. Sophisticated accent pieces adaptable to any setting. Discover the Fonte series.

Fonte features three tables for three uses. Coffee table, lounge table and night table each rest on sturdy oak legs to support either a marble, essence, or black back-painted glass tabletop. The subdued color hues of each tabletop harmonize with the coffee and black oak base options to create a contemporary interplay of solidity and fluidity.

Whether placed next to a sofa, in a central position for work or leisure, or as a bedside companion, these pieces combine style with functionality. The Fonte series pairs elegantly with the Ovidio bed from the 2023 Collection for a cohesive and sophisticated look, reflecting Van Duysen's vision of modern living.

products.title: Coffee Table - Marteen - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Equipped with a large surface area, the coffee tables play on the overlapping of tops and contrasts between the materials they are made of.

The Belgian designer has conceived the Marteen coffee tables as contemporary furniture elements that can be used individually or combined with each other, either independently or by combining them with seating systems to create interesting contrasts between soft and rigid materials. A dynamic, new and modern way of conceiving the living area.

The coffee tables reach their maximum expressiveness together with the Marteen seating system.

The coffee tables reach their maximum expressiveness together with the Marteen seating system. Dynamic domino solutions create a layering of volumes one on top of the other and create small private spaces, which can be opened with simple gestures to store personal items.

products.title: Coffee Table - 45°/tavolino - By Ron Gilad
products.description_html:
Ron Gilad’s new collection of furnishings, Grado°, underlines the designer’s interest in basic geometric shapes. 45°/tavolino.
Series of small tables with extra-light transparent crystal and smoked top, available in various sizes and marked by both a monochrome finish, american walnut or black oak, and by a bi-colour finish. Complex but essential shapes, “open box” table, of which we can only see the contours, able to integrate into all furnishing solutions with character.

45°/tavolino underlines the designer’s interest in complex but essential geometric “open box” shapes, of which we can only see the contours.

products.title: Coffee Table - Alisee - By Matteo Nunziati
products.description_html:
A complete and perfectly calibrated system of furnishings suitable for all rooms of the home, it surprises with its aesthetic balance and the rigorous proportions of the individual components.

The structure of the table creates a rhythm between solids and voids, enhanced by two finishes: Pewter and shiny antique Gold.

The two surfaces enrich the top part in wood, marble, fumè glass, and wood at the bottom. Refined materials and workmanship, attention to detail, for a family of elegant and refined contemporary furnishings

products.title: Coffee Table - Aster - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Aster coffee table, designed by Vincent Van Duysen, is the ultimate expression of compositional rationality and craftsmanship. A unique object made entirely by hand, a contemporary work of art that combines aesthetics and functionality. Each table has a slightly different connotation, testifying to its handcrafted nature.

Its base features a brass casting made with an earth mould that gives it the sophisticated hammered effect. The ring is mounted to the legs by welding. A vibratory finishing technique completes the aesthetics. With the help of stones, the structure is gently smoothed, giving it a wavy effect.

The top consists of an annealed glass with a thickness of 1.9 cm and distinguished at the bottom by a slight ripple that gives it personality. Here, too, the manufacturing technique is meticulous: the sheet is placed in a mold with a rusticated bottom and fused at a temperature of 180 degrees, giving the glass its typical finish.

Aster is available in two sizes: 50 cm in height with a 40 cm top in diameter, or 40 cm by 50 cm. Finishes are available in polished brass or black patinated brass, while the top can be customised in smocked glass or green. The Aster coffee table is a piece with a sculptural value, which can be used transversally to collections and spaces.

products.title: Coffee Table - Domino Next - By Nicola Gallizia
products.description_html: In his search for stylized forms and characterful materials, Nicola Gallizia develops a series of versatile and complementary units that can fit into each other or be set side by side, such as small oval tables and poufs. They are made using and alternating steel, wood, stone, textiles and leather. Color, matter and form are the inspiration and the synthesis of the collection.

products.title: Coffee Table - Louisa - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Vincent Van Duysen has designed Louisa, a set of round and oval coffee tables in which the presence of both wood and cement conveys an innovative tactile and aesthetic effect.

The load-bearing structure, a conical central plinth, is raised from the floor and inserted into a space hollowed out within it. Transversal objects, combined at will, simply, lightly, elegantly: the quintessence of modern design.

The table tops, a bit like suspended trays, come in ash, white or brick red cement or in eucalyptus wood and feature an original radial motif, achieved by means of a special procedure for joining up the slabs.

products.title: Coffee Table - Odile - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html:
The Odile coffee table by Christophe Delcourt combines striking design with versatile functionality, making it an ideal companion for contemporary living spaces. With its graphic lines and dynamic form, this table seamlessly integrates into the Emile sofa composition, while also standing out as a standalone piece.

The modular nature of Odile allows for flexible configurations, offering the possibility to adapt the table to different spatial needs.

Its hexagonal top is available in high-gloss lacquer or marble, framed by a glossy steel edge that adds a touch of refinement. The base, in rich coffee oak or black oak finishes, provides a grounding contrast to the sleek top.

Whether positioned as an integral part of the Emile sofa arrangement or placed independently to define a space, Odile enhances any living room with its sculptural elegance.

products.title: Coffee Table - Maylis - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html:
A study in contrast and refinement, Maylis is a sculptural coffee table that balances geometric precision with organic richness. Designed by Christophe Delcourt, its hexagonal-multiform top is available in marble, tempered glass, and glossy lacquered finishes, each offering a distinctive aesthetic to the table. This bold yet fluid design integrates seamlessly with Delcourt’s wider collection, bringing a sense of movement and versatility to contemporary interiors.

The interplay of materials defines Maylis—the smooth, polished surface meets the striking architectural base, composed of three pairs of half-moon aluminum legs arranged at varying heights. This dynamic structure creates an ever-changing visual effect, where light and shadow accentuate the depth of its design from every angle.

products.title: Coffee Table - Fleur - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html:
The Fleur coffee table by Christophe Delcourt embodies an exquisite fusion of craftsmanship and understated elegance. Featuring a rounded textured glass top, this delicate piece combines transparency and soft, organic lines, making it both sophisticated and versatile.

The table is supported by three curved legs that gently fan out in a concentric arrangement, evoking the petals of a flower in full bloom.

Compact and lightweight, Fleur offers both refinement and practicality. Its transparent top and gracefully curved structure allow it to seamlessly complement any interior, adding an airy, graceful quality to the space. Perfectly suited for a range of styles, Fleur blends beautifully into contemporary, minimalist, or more classic settings.

 

DIMENSIONS :

products.description_html: Low table with bicolour marble top with rounded edges. Base in wood covered with Gand, Faber or Vermeer fabric quilted with cannetté decorative motif. Metal proﬁles and buckle with metal logo available with polish chrome, polish gold or satin black nickel ﬁnish.

products.title: Coffee Table - Marty
products.description_html: Coffee table composed of three bases covered in marble and satin stainless steel. Smoked crystal top th. 8 mm boxed by UV bonding. products.title: Coffee Table - Lego Marble
products.description_html: Console in marble and aluminium. The marble part is made of a 30 mm thick slab for the top and legs, worked with bevelled edges and resin-fixed legs on the top using non-visible steel plates. Aluminium part is made by sand casting, textured, polished and lacquered by hand in any colour of the metal finish selection. The two elements can be mounted in three different configurations. products.title: Coffee Table - Lego
products.description_html:

Lego low table and console designed by Draga&Aurel for Visionnaire have been selected for the ADI Design Index 2021

products.title: Coffee Table - Kings Cross
products.description_html: Low table. Supporting frame in Canaletto walnut solid wood with open-pore natural ﬁnish and shaped three-lobes section. Lower shelf in wood with shiny RAL/NCS lacquer ﬁnish or upholstery in leather/fabric. Top in marble available with optional storage tray upholstered in leather or fabric.

products.title: Coffee Table - Kerwan
products.description_html:
CONCAVE VERSION
